title: Baseline
description: A Channel containing multiple different configuration and customization options.

title: Thumnail styles
description: An overview of all the different thumbnail styling options.

title: Promotional playlist
description: Highlight or brand a specific playlist by configuring its look and feel.

title: Watch history
description: Keep track of watched items and allow visitors to continue watching upon returning to the Channel.

title: Multi page
description: Group multiple Channels into a single embeddable Channel including navigation.

title: Promotional banners
description: Promote product and services directly from within a Channel.

title: Playlist collections
description: Group related content into a multi-layered Playlist. Ideal for recurring programs.

title: Content protection
description: Control access to your content using content protection based on country, embedding domain or behind a login.

title: Soft embargo
description: Show a countdown to upcoming live streams or announcements within a Channel.

title: Font sizes
description: Customize the sizes of Fonts within a Channel to ensure accessibility of the Channel.
